Name: Luny's Flower Crowns (bonus single flower) - Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]﻿
[center]They're finally here! Included in this pack are three flower crowns and one single flower tucked over the ear.
All items are colorable. The first two crowns that have both flowers and foliage have two tone coloring, so the flowers and foliage can be colored separately.





[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿!
Unzip the file and drop the folder, [FS] Luny's Flower Crowns, into your StardewValley/mods folder.
It'll now appear in the Fashion Sense menu.
[/center]
